# AgenQ

> AgenQ is a Toronto-based company. Its product, NINA, is an AI product assistant for SaaS and insurance software. NINA lives inside your product, understands what a user is trying to do, and carries out the steps for them, instead of only answering questions or showing where to click.

NINA works differently from a copilot or a digital adoption platform: it executes the workflow and confirms what changed. Pricing is per assistant, not per user.

## Pricing
- [Pricing](https://agenq.com/pricing/): Starter $199/month ($159/month billed annually), Growth $999/month ($799/month billed annually), Enterprise custom. 7-day free trial, no credit card required.
